source.title: Seasonality, Trend-following, and Mean reversion in Bitcoin

rule: Every UTC day buy BTC at 21:00 UTC and sell at 23:00 UTC.
data: Binance USD-M 1h OHLC used as spot price proxy.
execution: 21:00 open to 23:00 open, so both prices are tradable bar-boundary opens; no same-bar close assumption.
development_gate: base-cost net Sharpe >0.50 and positive total return
success_gate: OOS base-cost net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 6bps one-way, both 2024 and 2025 non-negative, max drawdown <25%
no_tuning: Hours are fixed from the source; no weekday or volatility filter is searched.
